ayahs.text: THE LAST HOUR draws near, and the moon is split asunder!
ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ

ayahs.text: But if they [who reject all thought of the Last Hour] were to see a sign [of its approach], they would turn aside and say, “An ever-recurring delusion!” –
ayahs.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ

ayahs.text: for they are bent on giving it the lie, being always wont to follow their own desires. Yet everything reveals its truth in the end.
ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ

ayahs.text: And withal, there has come unto them many a tiding that should have restrained [their arrogance]:
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ

ayahs.text: far-reaching wisdom [was held out to them]: but [since] all warnings have been of no avail,
ayahs.arabic: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ

ayahs.text: turn thou away from them. On the Day when the Summoning Voice will sum­mon [man] unto something that the mind cannot conceive,
ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ

ayahs.text: they will come forth from their graves, with their eyes downcast, [swarming about] like locusts scattered [by the wind],
ayahs.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ

ayahs.text: running in con­fusion towards the Summoning Voice; [and] those who [now] deny the truth will exclaim, “Calamitous is this Day!”
ayahs.arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ

ayahs.text: [LONG] BEFORE those [who now deny resurrec­tion] did Noah’s people call it a lie; and they gave the lie to Our servant and said, “Mad is he!” - and he was repulsed.
ayahs.arabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ

ayahs.text: Thereupon he called out to his Sustainer, “Verily, I am defeated; come Thou, then, to my succour!”
ayahs.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ

ayahs.text: And so We caused the gates of heaven to open with water pouring down in torrents,
ayahs.arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ

ayahs.text: and caused the earth to burst forth with springs, so that the waters met for a purpose pre-ordained:
ayahs.arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ

ayahs.text: but him We bore on that [vessel] made of [mere] planks and nails,
ayahs.arabic: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ

ayahs.text: and it floated under Our eyes: a recom­pense for him who had been rejected with ingratitude.
ayahs.arabic: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ

ayahs.text: And, indeed, We have caused such [floating vessels] to remain forever a sign [of Our grace unto man]: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

ayahs.text: And how severe is the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!
ayahs.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

ayahs.text: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

ayahs.text: TO THE TRUTH gave the lie [the tribe of] Ad: and how severe was the suffering which I inflicted when My warnings were disregarded!
ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

ayahs.text: Behold, We let loose upon them a raging storm wind on a day of bitter misfortune:
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ

ayahs.text: it swept the people away as though they were palm-trunks uprooted:
ayahs.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ

ayahs.text: for, how severe is the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!
ayahs.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

ayahs.text: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

ayahs.text: [AND the tribe of] Thamud gave the lie to all [Our] warnings;
ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

ayahs.text: and they said: “Are we to follow one single mortal, one from among ourselves? In that case, behold, we would certainly sink into error and folly!
ayahs.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ

ayahs.text: Why - on him alone from among all of us should a [divine] reminder have been bestowed? Nay, but he is a boastful liar!”
ayahs.arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ

ayahs.text: [And God said:] “On the morrow they will come to know who the boastful liar is!
ayahs.arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ

ayahs.text: Behold, [O Salih] We are letting loose this she-camel as a test for them; and thou but watch them, and contain thyself in patience.
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ

ayahs.text: And let them know that the water [of their wells] is to be divided between them, with each share of water equitably apportioned.”
ayahs.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ

ayahs.text: But they summoned their [boldest] companion, and he ventured [upon the evil deed], and cruelly slaughtered [the animal]:
ayahs.arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ

ayahs.text: and how severe was the suffering which I inflicted when My warnings were disregarded!
ayahs.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

ayahs.text: Behold, We let loose upon them one single blast [of Our punishment], and they became like the dried-up, crumbling twigs of a sheepfold.
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ

ayahs.text: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

ayahs.text: LOT ’S PEOPLE [too] gave the lie to all [Our] warn­ings:
ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

ayahs.text: [and so,] behold, We let loose upon them a deadly tempest; and only Lot ’s kinsfolk did We save at the break of dawn,
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ

ayahs.text: as a blessing from Us: thus do We reward all who are grateful.
ayahs.arabic: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ

ayahs.text: For he had truly warned them of Our punishing might; but they stubbornly cast doubt on these warn­ings,
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ

ayahs.text: and even demanded that he give up his guests [to them]: whereupon We deprived them of their sight [and thus told them, as it were]: “Taste, then, the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!”
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

ayahs.text: And, indeed, abiding suffering did befall them early on the morrow:
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ

ayahs.text: “Taste, then, the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!”
ayahs.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ

ayahs.text: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

ayahs.text: Now surely, unto Pharaoh’s folk [too] came such warnings;
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ

ayahs.text: they, too, gave the lie to all Our messages: and thereupon We took them to task as only the Almighty, who determines all things, can take to task.
ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ

ayahs.text: ARE, THEN, those of you who [now] deny the truth better than those others - or have you, per­chance, [been promised] immunity in the [ancient] books of [divine] wisdom?
ayahs.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

ayahs.text: Or do they say, “We are a group united, [and therefore] bound to prevail”?
ayahs.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ

ayahs.text: [Yet] the hosts [of those who deny the truth] shall be routed, and they shall turn their backs [in flight]!
ayahs.arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ

ayahs.text: But nay - the Last Hour is the time when they shall truly meet their fate; and that Last Hour will be most calamitous, and most bitter:
ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ

ayahs.text: for, behold, those who are lost in sin [will at that time come to know that it is they who] were sunk in error and folly!
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ

ayahs.text: On the Day when they shall be dragged into the fire on their faces, [they will be told:] “Taste now the touch of hell-fire!”
ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ

ayahs.text: BEHOLD, everything have We created in due measure and proportion;
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ

ayahs.text: and Our ordaining [a thing and its coming into being] is but one [act], like the twinkling of an eye.
ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ

ayahs.text: Thus, indeed, did We destroy people like you [in the past]: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?
ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ

ayahs.text: [They were truly guilty] because all [the evil] that they ever did had been [revealed to them as such] in the [ancient] books of [divine] wisdom;
ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ

ayahs.text: and everything [that man does], be it small or great, is recorded [with God].
ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ

ayahs.text: [Hence, too,] behold, the God-conscious will find themselves in [a paradise of] gardens and running waters,
ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ

ayahs.text: in a seat of truth, in the presence of a Sovereign who determines all things.
ayahs.arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
